rules: Abort before network access when MOOMOO_ACCESS_TOKEN is missing.
Never print, persist, hash, serialize or forward the bearer token into provider intake files.
Only GET quote/history-kline endpoints are allowed in P2-P2.
Provider entitlement errors stop the run and do not create partial success records for the affected symbol.
Raw provider bodies may be persisted only after headers and credentials are excluded.
Successful live import writes sanitized payloads to market-provider-intake-v1.json; evidence admission still requires W8A-P2 normalization, W8B claims and W8C CWA.
